Dans un milieu favorable, elle reste presque introuvable.

Pour en tirer ses propriétés, elle se consomme directement.

This liquid is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in heaths, scrublands, and moors.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains almost impossible to find.

To obtain its properties, it is consumed directly.

Level 10 respiratory poison distilled from Sweet Galenas and white wine. It causes extreme drowsiness or a suggestible trance that can last for dozens of hours.

Repeated use can lead to habituation.
